_source: A Night Off design doc pp. 36-37 (The cartel's wares). Minutes are game minutes.

wares.name: Sea Salt
wares.catch: Your hands shake for 5 minutes: darts, pool and golf are hopeless.

wares.name: Lamp Oil
wares.effect: +30% charisma for 5 minutes; your captions become eloquent.
wares.catch: Afterwards -30% for 5 minutes, and you tell everyone the truth.

wares.name: Barnacle
wares.effect: +50% toughness for 5 minutes, no pain (damage taken -30%).
wares.catch: You can't stop fighting: anyone who bumps you is a fight, and the police count it as armed.

wares.name: Kelp Smoke
wares.effect: Everything is funny: +15 mood for every patron within 5 m while you laugh.
wares.catch: You laugh during conversations, which fails every serious option. The Reverend hates it.

wares.name: Angler's Light
wares.effect: You see every patron's trait icons, and the thieves glow.
wares.catch: You also see people who aren't there, and the fortune teller's cards change when you look at them.

wares.name: Deep Pressure
wares.effect: Time slows for you in games: aim, timing and card tells are easy for 3 minutes.
wares.catch: The meter climbs 20 when it wears off, and you miss the next 2 minutes of the night.

wares.name: The Siren
wares.effect: Everyone in the room is Delighted with you for 3 minutes; any flirt's offer comes early.
wares.catch: Every flirt's offer is from whoever is closest, thieves included, and your sober friends can't talk you out of it.

wares.name: The Cocktail
wares.effect: The quiet man mixes it himself: one of six outcomes, equal odds.
wares.catch: One of the six is waking up without a kidney.

cocktail: The best night of your life: every stat maxed for 10 minutes, a sincere go-home guaranteed, and 300 in your pocket.
You can fly. You can't, but you're sure of it: +40% toughness for 10 minutes.
You're the bartender for 10 minutes: your drinks are free, and every drink poured tips you.
The goat and you understand each other. It follows you, and it bites for you.
You wake up in the morning, at once, with a headline you didn't earn and both kidneys.
You wake up in the morning, at once, without a kidney.
skipped: Things happened. You have a tattoo of an anchor. It's upside down.
Things happened. Someone has drawn a moustache on you.
Things happened. Your pockets are 30 lighter.
Things happened. Your pockets are 40 heavier, and you don't know why.
Things happened. A regular you've never spoken to calls you by a nickname.
